scheme_name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Pre Matric Scholarship for Studying Transgender
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the transgender community
Applicant must be studying at the primary to pre‑matric level
Applicant must be enrolled in a recognized school within Rajasthan
benefits_summary: ₹225 per month for 10 months (₹2,250 total) transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
